The '''unidentified Jedi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Galidraan]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] and was successful in killing [[Myles]] during the battle. He was killed by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] soon after.

==Biography==
The unidentified [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was part of the [[Jedi task force]] sent to stop the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] army led by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the Jedi were tracked down the Mandalorians and called on them to surrender, promising a fair treatment if doing so, but bring "swift justice" if they choose to fight against them. Fett arrived at the scene and ordered his men to open fire at the Jedi. When their blaster bolts reflected back at them, the Mandalorians switched to using [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] as the battle commenced. During the confrontation, a Mandalorian known as [[Myles]] attempted to give Fett air support, but the unidentified Jedi used [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jump]] to reach Myles and [[Sai tok/Legends|cut him in half]]. An angered Jango Fett killed five Jedi with his bare hands in retaliation. The unknown Jedi continued fighting until near the end of the battle, when he was personally confronted by Fett himself. Fett attacked the Jedi, and after a brief fight, the Mandalorian killed him.

==Powers and abilities==
The unidentified Jedi was adept at using Force Jump, and was able to jump high enough to reach Myles, who had been in flight. He was proficient in sai tok [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and was able to survive the violent battle until his showdown with Fett.
